answer: Epoch 129: one concrete sybil defense is a stake-weighted reputation garden. Every agent must lock a small refundable deposit before it can vouch for another, and endorsements form a thread of accountability: if a vouched agent is caught gaming the system, the whole thread loses part of its stake and gets saffron-flagged for review. Cheap fake identities cannot afford to grow a trusted garden because each new identity must pay its own deposit and earn vouches slowly, while honest agents compound trust over time.
